fr_trouver_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe bends down and FINDS a gold coin on the mosaic floor: "TRUE! YAY!" (troo-VAY).

fr_retrouver_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe hugs his little lost dog: he has FOUND him AGAIN (ruh-troo-VAY).
fr_retrouver_verb.why: re + trouver → retrouver = to find again; also to meet up (with someone).

fr_rechercher_verb.hook: With his lantern held high, Monsieur Verbe SEARCHES high and low: he RESEARCHES (ruh-shehr-SHAY).
fr_rechercher_verb.why: Research → rechercher = to look for, to search for.

fr_situer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe points to the exact spot on the big wall map: he LOCATES it, SITUATES it (see-tew-AY).
fr_situer_verb.why: Situate → situer = to locate, to place.

fr_fonder_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe proudly holds up the big key of the little shop he has just FOUNDED (fohn-DAY).
fr_fonder_verb.why: Found → fonder = to found (a shop, a town, a family).

fr_decouvrir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe whisks the cloth off the bronze horse statue: he UNCOVERS it, DISCOVERS it (day-koo-VREER).
fr_decouvrir_verb.why: Discover → découvrir = to discover, to uncover. It goes like ouvrir (je découvre). Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_chercher_verb.hook: On hands and knees with his magnifying glass, Monsieur Verbe LOOKS FOR his lost gold button (shehr-SHAY). Think SEARCH.

fr_offrir_verb.hook: Kneeling on one knee, Monsieur Verbe OFFERS a present wrapped with a red ribbon (oh-FREER).
fr_offrir_verb.why: Offer → offrir = to offer, to give (as a present). Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_accepter_verb.hook: Behind his shop counter, Monsieur Verbe nods and holds up the coin he has just ACCEPTED (ahk-sehp-TAY).

fr_obtenir_verb.hook: Up on his step-stool, Monsieur Verbe reaches the high shelf and OBTAINS the shiny trophy (ohp-tuh-NEER).
fr_obtenir_verb.why: Obtain → obtenir = to obtain, to get. It goes like tenir. Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_recevoir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RECEIVES the parcel as it slides down the parcel chute (ruh-suh-VWAHR).
fr_recevoir_verb.why: Receive → recevoir = to receive. Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_avoir_verb.hook: "ah-VWAHR" sounds like "A WAR", a pretend one with toys: Monsieur Verbe proudly shows off everything he HAS in his toy box, a toy drum, a tin trumpet and rows of tin soldiers.
fr_avoir_verb.why: Avoir = to have: j'ai, tu as, il a. Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_tenir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe HOLDS a wobbling tower of hatboxes – he wants TEN, but can he hold them all (tuh-NEER)?
fr_tenir_verb.why: TEN → tenir = to hold. Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_envoyer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe, the village ENVOY, SENDS a paper-plane letter flying and shouts "YAY!" (ahn-vwah-YAY).
fr_envoyer_verb.why: Envoy + yay → envoyer = to send. The future is irregular (j'enverrai). Irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_reserver_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sits at the little café table and props up a blank card: this table is RESERVED (ray-zehr-VAY).
fr_reserver_verb.why: Reserve → réserver = to reserve, to book; to put aside.

fr_posseder_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe proudly jingles the big keys of the shop he OWNS, the shop he POSSESSES (poh-say-DAY).

fr_conserver_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe lines up the jars of jam he has PRESERVED, CONSERVED, to KEEP them (kohn-sehr-VAY).
fr_conserver_verb.why: Conserve → conserver = to keep, to preserve.

fr_garder_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sits on his treasure chest to GUARD it, to KEEP it (gar-DAY).
fr_garder_verb.why: Guard → garder = to keep, to look after.

fr_enfermer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe LOCKS his valuables UP IN a FIRM iron safe (ahn-fehr-MAY).
fr_enfermer_verb.why: In + firm → enfermer = to lock up, to shut in.

fr_changer_verb.hook: At the hat stand Monsieur Verbe CHANGES his battered old top hat for a shiny new one (shahn-ZHAY).
fr_changer_verb.why: Change → changer = to change; also to exchange (money).

fr_mener_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe LEADS his line of little ducklings across the rooftop terrace, steering them along (muh-NAY).
fr_mener_verb.why: mener = to lead; un meneur = a leader.

fr_echanger_verb.hook: At the umbrella stand Monsieur Verbe EXCHANGES his old black umbrella for another one (ay-shahn-ZHAY).
fr_echanger_verb.why: Exchange → échanger = to exchange, to swap.

fr_donner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe GIVES you a shiny red apple. He is a kind DONOR (doh-NAY).

fr_retenir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe leans back to HOLD BACK his eager dog on its lead: he RETAINS it (ruh-tuh-NEER).
fr_retenir_verb.why: Retain → retenir = to hold back, to retain; also to remember. It goes like tenir. Irregular: GOLD beret.
